headline: Board denied property tax assessment appeal for 522 Island Ave., Parcel ID 090 AA004001, filed by Theodore W. Haykal.
summary: The Board of Assessment Review heard the appeal of Theodore W. Haykal regarding the assessment of 522 Island Ave., Parcel ID 090 AA004001. After presentations from the appellant and the Assessor, the Board found it had jurisdiction, denied the appeal, and authorized the Board's Attorney to prepare a written decision.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 14, 2026 Board of Assessment Review Meeting by a roll call vote of 3-0.
Found that the Board has jurisdiction to hear the appeal of 522 Island Ave., by a roll call vote of 3-0.
Denied the appeal of the assessment of 522 Island Ave., finding the applicant did not meet their burden of showing the assessment was substantially overvalued, by a roll call vote of 3-0.
Authorized the Board's Attorney to prepare a written decision to be reviewed and signed within 10 days, by a roll call vote of 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Board member Lowry moved to approve the minutes of the September 14, 2026 Board of Assessment Review Meeting. Board Chair Larsson seconded the motion, which was approved by a roll call vote of (3-0).
Board member Lowry moved to find that the Board has jurisdiction to hear the appeal, which was seconded by Board Chair Larsson, which passed by a roll call vote of (3-0).

Board Chair Larsson moved to find that the applicant did not meet their burden of showing that the assessment of the property was substantially overvalued, and therefore to deny the appeal. Board member Lowry seconded the motion, which was passed by a roll call vote of (3-0).

Board Chair Larsson moved to authorize the Board's Attorney to prepare a written decision to be reviewed and signed within 10 days. Board member Lowry seconded the motion, which passed by a roll call vote of (3-0).
